title: A parcel for Max
scene: Max loves online shopping. He finds headphones in the catalog of a site, uses a coupon, checks the status of his order and meets the courier, but the product has a defect and looks like a fake, so he sells it on a marketplace.

title: Sofia's first fashion show
scene: Max's sister Sofia studies to be a fashion designer and shows her first collection at a fashion show. Supermodels wear her couture - a corset, a cape, jackets in cashmere, tweed, flannel and khaki - and she explains why she likes natural material and textile, not nylon or polyester.

title: Around Kyiv by metro
scene: Anna's cousin comes on his first visit to Kyiv, a city of three million people. Anna explains public transport, an inspector checks their tickets in the metro, and the long escalator takes them up to the city center; on the avenue near the park and the monuments a woman says 'Excuse me, mister, you dropped your wallet', and they ask a policeman the way.

title: Taxi to the airport
scene: Anna is flying to a summer course in London. Max helps her put her stuff in a taxi; the driver uses GPS and takes the highway - forty kilometers, thirty minutes max - and stops at the terminal next to the free shuttle buses.

title: Anna's first flight
scene: At the airport there is chaos. Anna's baggage is twenty kilograms, she shows her passport and visa at passport control, buys chocolate at the duty-free and sees a celebrity going into business class; on the aeroplane a steward brings coffee, her bag gets lost in transit, and in London she has jet lag.

title: Booking a hotel for the weekend
scene: Max books a cheap hotel in Lviv for the weekend; the booking says four people maximum and a fee for a no-show. At reception the check-in is quick, they get the Wi-Fi password, find their room at the end of the corridor and hear that check-out is at eleven.

title: A night in a luxury hotel
scene: Anna wins a night in a luxury hotel in a competition. The concierge meets her in the foyer, her room has a king-size bed and a jacuzzi, she tries the spa and the sauna, and orders breakfast from room service.

title: Max's new scooter
scene: Max buys an electric scooter to get to college faster. On the smooth asphalt by the river he races a biker, forgets the speed limit in a tunnel and nearly hits a bicycle with a red reflector; the cyclist stops pedaling, and the incident ends with a shout.

title: Dad buys a car
scene: Anna's dad is a car enthusiast who watches every grand prix and wants a new automobile for the family. At the dealer's showroom he looks at a supercar and a limousine, but chooses between a sedan and a diesel minivan, takes a test drive and asks about leasing; Anna's driving instructor comes too.

scene: On the way to the dacha Dad presses the accelerator, but the motor stops. A mechanic from an auto repair shop takes the car to his garage, uses a loud air compressor, cleans the carburetor, checks the chassis and fixes the bumper.

scene: In summer Max and his cousin go on a road trip in America in a camper and an old jeep with a turbo. They drive off-road with the phone in a holder for the map, pay four dollars a gallon, follow a pickup to a cheap motel and eat cheeseburgers, and the cousin tries bourbon.
